noun_definition: Composer refers to the text input area in a chat interface where users can type their messages.
Cursor position refers to the location of the text input point within the composer box that should remain unchanged after refreshing the page.

start of message refers to the initial position of the cursor in the composer box after a page refresh, which is expected to remain at the point where the user was typing rather than resetting to the beginning.
Page refresh refers to the action of reloading the current webpage, which in this context causes the cursor position in the composer box to reset to the beginning of the message.
